_comment: The channel line-up this demo publishes, kept deliberately identical in name, source clip and
stream directory to rt-mbs-examples' and rt-dvb-i-examples' own channels.json, so the three
demos show the same content under the same names.
Per channel:
id        stable identifier, used in log lines and in the xMB service name
name      what the service is called wherever a name is shown
source    file under $CONTENT_ROOT that the looping live encoder plays
stream    directory the encoder writes under the media origin's public/ directory
type      linear or radio, the DVB-I demo's own vocabulary. A radio channel is encoded
audio-only: see live-encoder.sh for why that matters over a broadcast bearer
onAir     true if this channel is carried over the air as its own xMB service. The others
are still encoded and served by the origin, so every demo offers the same four
channels; they are simply not broadcast here.
tmgiServiceId, tsi, mcastAddr, mcastPort
the MBMS bearer this channel's session uses. Required when onAir, and each must
be unique across the on-air channels: two sessions sharing a TMGI or a multicast
group would collide in the BM-SC and on the air.
One channel is on air, matching the MBS demo, so the two broadcast demos carry the same
single service. This demo's radio stack does carry two at once -- both were delivered, with
the modem reporting BLER 0.000 on both MCHs -- so a second channel can be put back on air by
setting onAir on it; its bearer parameters are already assigned below.
